name: BSP-XMPVO
aliases: Binary Space Partition - Extended Monotone Polygon Visibility Ordering
definition: An algorithm that improves XMPVO results by building a view-independent BSP tree of the exterior faces to reduce the number of ray shooting queries needed.
summary: BSP-XMPVO is a visibility sorting algorithm for unstructured grids that combines BSP trees with MPVO to provide exact ordering for non-convex meshes.
